summary: Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch and TensorFlow inference, uncommitted. Changes: pytorch.json and tensorflow.json gain a graviton inference processor plus Graviton-only versions 1.12.1 and 2.9.1 (container_version ubuntu20.04-sagemaker). image_uris.py gains _is_graviton_family(), graviton selection in _processor(), a -graviton repository suffix with cpu tagging in retrieve(), and ValueErrors for unsupported Graviton or processor combinations. Verified: the spec's PyTorch (ml.c6g.4xlarge, version 1.12.1, image_scope="inference") and TensorFlow (ml.t4g.2xlarge, version 2.9.1) URIs match exactly. Test status: tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_retrieve.py and the rest of image_uris pass (526 passed), but 4 tests in test_dlc_frameworks.py fail (test_pytorch_inference[py2/py3-1.12.1] and test_tensorflow_inference[py2/py3-2.9.1]) because those tests expect cpu images for every configured version and the new versions are Graviton-only. Blocked decision: whether 1.12.1 and 2.9.1 also need x86 cpu/gpu entries (tags not verifiable offline) or the tests should exclude Graviton-only versions. Caveats: the spec example omits image_scope and version, which the existing code requires; the jumpstart test directory was not run; a temporary mock shim in /tmp was used because mock is missing from the shared venv.
